senses.gloss:
ind.
A particle implying,
1 Cause, (thus, therefore.)
2 Manifestation, (lo! behold!)
3 Something additional, (et cetera.)
4 The meanings of एव, (so thus, even, in this manner)
5 Conclusion, enough, (finis.)
6 Reference, (so says, this is, &c.) It also implies,
7 Order, arrangement, specific or distinctive, and
8 Identity (of this or similar form.)
9 A grammatical copulative, indicating a preceding sound or sense, to be again intended.
E.
इ to go, क्तिच् aff.

f. (-तिः)
1 Calamity of season, as drought, excessive rain, rats, foreign invasion, &c.
2 Travelling in foreign countries, sojourning.
3 An affray.
E.
ईङ to go, affix क्तिन्.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
1 Unworthy of trust, not fit to be credited.
2 Wicked, lost.
f. (-था)
Unmeaning or nonsensical discourse.
E.
इति this, so, and कथा a saying.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
What is proper or necessary to be done.
E.
इति so, कर्त्तव्य to be done.

f. (-ता)
Proper and right measures.
E.
इतिकर्त्तव्य with तल् added, or with त्व, इतिकर्त्तव्यत्वं.

ind.
Traditional instruction, advice, &c. mutually imparted.
E.
इति so, thus, and ह tidings.

m. (-सः)
History, traditional accounts of former events, heroic history, as the Mahābhārata and Rāmāyaṇa.
E.
इतिह traditional instruction, अस to be, and घञ् aff.
